component.name: Loböle
component.summary: Parametric B-Rep CAD for parts, assemblies, drawings, and simulation

description.p: Designer is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built around a deterministic, scriptable document model. Create constrained sketches, solid features, assemblies, drawings, configurations, and FEM studies.
Projects use a diffable format with checkpoints and Git-backed history, while the same command layer is available to the GUI, Python, and MCP automation clients.
